title: Juniper and the Will
author: O. M. Almeida
blurb: Tamsin Lockridge, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
